design_philosophy.core_promise: Satu Kartu. Satu Tap. Semua Terhubung. Lifetime Garansi Link.

typography.primary_heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-400 tracking-wide uppercase

public_landing_theme.mode: Dark Premium with High Contrast Gold/Cyan Accents

colors.contrast_rules: All text must meet minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface. Explicit hover text colors required (e.g. hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white).

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 sm:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.mobile_constraints: Images must not exceed max-h-[80vh] on mobile viewports.

public_website.navigation_header: Fixed header with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800/60 z-50. Must include Logo (Short Card / GlobalConnex), Links (Fitur, Cara Kerja, Gunakan Untuk, Garansi, Masuk Admin), CTA 'Aktifkan Kartu' + CS WhatsApp.
public_website.hero_section: Hero text: 'Satu Kartu. Satu Tap. Semua Terhubung.' Subtitle: 'Solusi Kartu NFC + QR Code cerdas untuk meningkatkan Google Review, Medsos & Kontak Bisnis tanpa ganti kartu selamanya.' CTA buttons: 'Aktifkan Kartu' & 'Ajukan Koreksi Link'. Showcase 3D/realistic NFC Card mockups (Black & White variants).
public_website.benefits_grid: 6 Core Benefits Cards: NFC + QR Code, Tanpa Aplikasi Tambahan, Custom Logo Bisnis, Variat Black & White, Easy to Update Server-Side, Lifetime Garansi Link.
public_website.use_cases_section: Platforms supported: Google Review, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, WhatsApp, Custom Link with interactive platform badges & preview mockups.
public_website.card_mockups_interactive: Interactive Card Variant Selector (Hitam / Putih), 3D flip card effect showing Front (Logo + NFC chip indicator) and Back (QR Code + Public Short URL '/r/SC-0001').
public_website.how_it_works_steps: 4 Simple Steps: 1. Terima Kartu → 2. Tap NFC / Scan QR → 3. Aktivasi Link → 4. Langsung Terhubung.
public_website.activation_flow_form: Multi-step mobile-first wizard: Step 1 Validation (Enter Kode Kartu e.g. SC-0001), Step 2 Destination Type (Google Review, Instagram, WhatsApp, Custom URL, etc.), Step 3 Business Details & URL input, Step 4 Optional Logo Upload, Step 5 Summary & Activation Confirmation.
public_website.link_correction_request: Form page: Card Code, Business Name, Current Link, Requested New Link, Reason for Correction, Requester Name, WhatsApp Number, Email, Submit button with confirmation state.
public_website.footer: GlobalConnex branding, Quick links, CS WhatsApp direct button, Copyright notice, Privacy policy & Terms.

admin_dashboard.sidebar_nav: Left navigation sidebar (Dashboard Stats, Cards Management, Merchant Businesses, Link Corrections Queue, Audit Log / History, Settings).
admin_dashboard.stats_overview: Key KPI widgets: Total Cards, Active Cards, Unassigned Cards, Disabled Cards, Total Merchants, Pending Corrections.
admin_dashboard.cards_table: Data table with Search, Filter by Status (Active, Unassigned, Disabled), Sort, Pagination, Actions (Assign, Activate, Edit Link, View Detail Modal, Disable).
admin_dashboard.card_detail_modal: Detail modal with high-res QR code generator/download button, public short link generator (/r/{code}), destination URL, current merchant info, change history timeline.
admin_dashboard.corrections_queue: Queue cards/table with Approve / Reject actions, old link vs new link comparison, internal note input, instant update trigger.
admin_dashboard.settings_panel: General settings, Default destination domains, System notifications, Admin credentials.

motion_and_animations.card_3d_hover: perspective-1000 rotateY hover effects for physical card mockups
motion_and_animations.toast_notifications: sonner library for instant feedback on activation, copy link, and status changes

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, badges, tabs, and modals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-activate-button', data-testid='card-activation-code-input', data-testid='admin-sidebar-cards-link').
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px clickable/touchable area on all mobile elements.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_routing: Implement client-side SPA routing or tabbed view supporting: Landing Page (/), Card Activation Wizard (/aktivasi), Link Correction Form (/koreksi), Public Short Link Redirection Preview (/r/:cardCode), and Admin Dashboard (/admin).
instructions_to_main_agent.2_state_management: Use LocalStorage or mock state store populated with realistic Indonesian business data (e.g. Warung Kopi Senja SC-0001 -> Google Maps, Klinik Sehat SC-0002 -> WhatsApp, Barber SC-0003 -> Instagram) to simulate real-time activation, redirection updates, and correction approvals.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_mobile_first: Prioritize seamless, high-touch mobile UX with smooth multi-step forms, copy-to-clipboard buttons, QR download, and instant Sonner toast feedback.
